parts.name: display-cover
parts.model_overhangs_review: Printed face down with both 34 mm skirts pointing up. The visible face takes the textured plate, the plate's hidden face is a top surface, and the skirts rise as plain 2 mm walls. Each lip's square catch face is the only print-down surface; with the small-overhang filter off and a 0.24 mm top gap, each gets one bed-rooted support standing beside the cover's edge, outside the part. Cleanup precedes fitting; actual effort is unmeasured.

trees.contact_region: The -X lip's 1.8 mm square catch face at the skirt's far end, across its 24 mm run.
trees.removal_lane: The support stands 30 mm tall on the plate outboard of the cover's -X edge, in open air beside the skirt; no part of the cover surrounds it. Rock it outboard off the catch face and lift it off the plate.
trees.removal_direction_original_cad: +Z off the catch face, then -X outboard, clear of the part.
trees.preserved_working_face_reason: The catch face is the lip's retaining shoulder under the housing's pocket roof; peel the interface off whole and leave the printed ledge flat.

native_log_diagnostics_review: The three exact diagnostics are T1001, T65535 and T65279. T1001 is emitted in the saved-profile startup Hotend Type Detection block; T65535 and T65279 occur in the saved-profile end-code unload/control blocks after all model layers. All three tokens are present in petgf.3mf machine_start_gcode/machine_end_gcode, and this native slice preserves them. Native return code is 0, the plate warning is empty, and all model/support paths are present. These parser messages do not identify a changed support path or a model slicing failure.
